subject: Onsite demo blocked by vendor intake — propose remote briefing + intake sync
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Amber Liu <amber.liu@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Onsite demo the week of Apr 16 (travel + vendor intake)

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the time last month. We'd like to host an onsite demo at our Boston office the week of Apr 16 to include ops, security, and our VP of Product. Amber and I pulled tentative travel approvals, but procurement flagged that we need completed vendor onboarding (vendor portal profile) and an updated security attestation before travel is greenlit.

I've attached the vendor intake form they sent — procurement says they won't approve travel until the questionnaire + SOC references are in. Is there a way to proceed with an on-prem demo before procurement clears the vendor portal? If not, can we convert to a half-day remote technical briefing while we complete ingestion into their vendor system?

Best,
Sanjay
Director, Digital Transformation
NovaMed

[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
Cc: Amber Liu <amber.liu@novamed.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo the week of Apr 16 (travel + vendor intake)

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the intake form.

Short answer: procurement gating + the travel window makes an onsite risky this close to Apr 16. Our compliance team (cc'd: Neha) needs the completed questionnaire + the signed NDA before we can be added to customer systems or approve engineers traveling on a vendor visit.

Two quick options to keep momentum:
- Option A (recommended): Convert the meeting to a 90–120 min remote technical briefing (recorded) next Tue/Thu AM so your execs and engineers can see product fit while procurement completes intake. We'll run a focused runbook (SLA/costs, security packet, SSO/attestation).
- Option B: Keep the onsite and move it to the week of May 6 — gives you time for procurement to finish the portal steps and for us to gather SOC/attestation artifacts.

We can also run a 30-min intake sync with procurement to walk them through the vendor portal fields (we've found that speeds approvals). I'll have Priyom (SE) and Neha (security) join that call.

If you want Option A, pick two preferred windows and we'll send a calendar invite. If Option B, let us know available dates in May and we'll hold a travel-friendly slot.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first inference for builders

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo the week of Apr 16 (travel + vendor intake)

Hey all — quick technical note from the SE perspective.

If procurement won't provide test tenants or firewall exceptions prior to the visit, an onsite has very little marginal benefit vs. a remote briefing for the discovery and architecture discussion. For the remote session I propose we:
- Provide a short pre-read (10 slides) mapping integration touchpoints (SSO, data flow, retention).
- Run a live playback of a 20-min replay and a short Q&A on deployment modes (hosted vs. private).
- Offer an optional 1:1 follow-up lab with their infra team once procurement grants portal access.

I can prep the pre-read and a sanitized demo snapshot that doesn't require tenant provisioning. If procurement wants to accelerate, we can join their vendor intake call and fill fields live — that often reduces back-and-forth and removes the travel blocker.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_security_snapshot.pdf (PDF)]

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novamed.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: Amber Liu <amber.liu@novamed.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Onsite demo the week of Apr 16 (travel + vendor intake)

Lauren, Priyom — thanks, this is helpful. Amber and I talked it over and we'll take Option A: convert to a remote technical briefing next Thursday 4/12 at 10:30am ET. That avoids last-minute travel approvals and gets our stakeholders in front of your team sooner.

I'll share the completed intake form by EOD Thu and ask procurement to join a 30-min intake walkthrough on Fri (we'll invite Neha). I've attached the signed NDA — procurement wanted that on file before any technical walkthroughs referencing security artifacts.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to the brief.

Sanjay

[Attachment: redwood_ndasigned.pdf (PDF)]
